drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un petit croquis barré : un trait horizontal partant de $S$, d'où pendent des traits verticaux en forme de boucles ; le tout est surchargé de gribouillis, ainsi que les mots écrits au-dessous.
drawings.kind: sketch of sheets over a base, struck
drawings.notes: Struck on the page, as the transcription says (re-read there on 700 dpi tiles): the right half of the sketch and the words under it are covered with scribbles. Struck material is not drawn, so the redraw is empty; the record is kept so that the figure can be retired or omitted. What can be seen under the strokes: the letter S at the left, a horizontal stroke leaving it to the right, and two or three long narrow loops hanging from that stroke (vertical lines joined at the bottom), the last ones lost in the scribble; below, struck words beginning « S x ... ». On a 200 dpi render the left part (S, the horizontal stroke, the first loop) carries no strike of its own. The arrow diagram below the sketch (X, T, S, H, H x_S T = union of the H_i x_S T) is not part of it. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut à gauche, un croquis~: une grande région marquée « \uncertain{qu.~cpt} », contenant deux ouverts qui se recoupent, notés $U_f$ et $U_g$, avec leur intersection notée \uncertain{$U_f \cap U_g$}~; un petit cercle au-dessus, et un cercle barré plus à droite~; un $\overline{X}$ isolé.
drawings.kind: open sets in a region (Venn sketch)
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. The large region (one closed ink curve, ending at the upper right in a hook that runs into "qu. cpt"), the two overlapping ovals U_f and U_g inside it with U_f and U_g beside them and U_f cap U_g under them, a faint pencil oval behind U_f (not in the transcription), the small circle above, and the isolated X-bar. Left out: the struck circle at the upper right and the stroke striking it (struck), a small mark at the left inside the region (an arrow or a 4), the typed text showing through. The labels qu. cpt and U_f cap U_g remain uncertain readings, as in the transcription. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, en face de la Prop.~1, deux segments obliques parallèles gradués de petits traits, marqués de lettres (sans doute $x$, $y$)
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. Two parallel oblique segments, the long one below, the short one above it, each graduated with small ticks placed on the segment (perpendicular, computed from its end points): four on the long one, three on the short one plus a heavier cross-like mark at its lower end. The letter at the lower end of the long segment is read x. The second letter (y according to the transcription) is not located with certainty: the small marks just above the short segment near its middle (a J-like stroke) and near its upper end (a small o) are its candidates, and are left out. The strokes to the right belong to the text. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge inférieure gauche, un ovale traversé par un trait oblique
drawings.notes: An oval crossed by an oblique stroke, in the lower left margin.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un segment oblique gradué de petits traits, marqué $\complement V$ en haut et $F$ au milieu
drawings.notes: An oblique segment graduated with small ticks, marked complement V at the top and F in the middle (labels after the transcription; on the page they sit on the ticks).

drawings.description: deux flèches descendent de $\mathfrak{X}$ et de $\mathfrak{X}_\xi$ et convergent vers un même point, sans but écrit.
drawings.notes: Two arrows go down from frak X and frak X_xi and converge at one point, with no target written.
